page.overview:
Who is Ferren Barr?

Ferren Barr was an Iktotchi male fallen Jedi who sought to avenge the Jedi Order by overthrowing the Sith-ruled Galactic Empire. Despite his altruistic motives, Barr resorted to methods contrary to the Jedi Code, using the Force to control his followers and assassinating the Imperial ambassador to Mon Cala. However, his actions ensured that the Mon Calamari would ultimately join the Alliance to Restore the Republic, becoming an essential part of the fight to restore democracy to the galaxy.

A Padawan during the last years of the Republic Era, Barr served in the Clone Wars until the Galactic Republic was reformed as the Galactic Empire. He managed to survive the immediate execution of Order 66, unlike other Jedi officers who were killed by their clone troopers, and escaped into exile while the New Order rose to power. During the early days of the Imperial Era, Barr formed a plan to undermine Galactic Emperor Darth Sidious' rule. Using his position as an advisor to King Lee-Char, Barr orchestrated a conflict between the Empire and the Mon Calamari monarchy, resulting in the king's capture, the Imperial Military's invasion of Mon Cala, and Barr's death in a lightsaber duel against the Sith Lord Darth Vader.

Ultimately, Barr's prophecy was realized through the victory of the Rebel Alliance. Bolstered by remnants of the Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet, the Alliance Military defeated the Empire's forces in the Battle of Endor, while the deaths of Sidious and Vader fulfilled the prophesied destruction of the Sith.

Ferren Barr began his training in the ways of the Force as a Padawan of the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. In his time as a padawan, he sparred with Anakin Skywalker in lightsaber combat on at least one occasion. As a result, he fled into exile while the Sith, ancient enemies of the Jedi Order, returned to power through the rise of the Galactic Empire.
